preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the sequence length n is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in seq) for seq in sequences)
preconditions.description: For each test case, every element in the sequence is an integer between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) == min(max(seq), min(a & b for a in seq for b in seq)) for line, seq in zip(output_lines, sequences))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output integer is the minimum possible maximum value achievable, which equals the minimum of the maximum element in the original sequence and the bitwise AND of all pairs of elements in the sequence.
